sources_tried: Seed file research/installers/raw/seeds/augusta.json: read. The Maps results were mostly plumbers and remodelers. The only partition-specific hits were Coach Partitions and RSA (restroomstallsandall.com).
Nearby area files atlanta.json, columbia.json, savannah.json and charlotte.json: used to cross-check regional Division 10 firms.
Bobrick find-a-rep (bobrick.com/find-a-rep): worked but returned no rep, because the dropdown results are not in the static page.
Scranton Products where-to-buy: worked. It shows only the territory rep, Southern States Architectural Sales (678.425.8796), covering GA and SC, with no installers listed.
ASI, Bradley, Hadrian, Metpar, General Partitions and Ampco locators: not tried separately because of the fetch budget. ASI and Global Partitions turned up only as a manufacturer in search results.
The Blue Book: listing pages returned 403 (blocked). Only search snippets were seen, for New South Specialties, Partition Plus and Division 10 Specialties South (Trion GA, too far).

WebSearch: all 8 allowed searches used (Augusta toilet partition installation, Division 10 Augusta, Aiken/North Augusta/Evans, Blue Book Augusta, furnish-and-install Augusta, SC Columbia/Aiken/Lexington, GA Augusta/Macon/Athens, Fort Gordon subcontractor). None found a Division 10 partition installer based in Augusta itself.

BBB category pages: Augusta GA partitions, Aiken SC partitions and Augusta shower all worked. They list only Atlanta or Charlotte firms, plus residential remodelers such as Southern Industries; no local partition installer.
One Point Partitions: found in search with an Augusta 'delivery terminal' (Doug Barnard Pkwy). It is an online seller and competitor, not a confirmed installer, so it was excluded.
Tallo job posting (Precision Walls Division 10 installer, Lexington SC): returned 410. Only the search snippet was seen.

Company sites fetched: coachpartitions.com, restroomstallsandall.com, terminusspecialties.com, precisionwalls.com, mccarthyinc.com, natspec.net, newsouthspecialties.com, mavenaccessories.com, accessoriesunlimited.net, masonhall.com (no service area; about 150 miles away, so excluded), inexsystems.com (page truncated; excluded), adamsinstalledproducts.com, carpentersinthehome.com.

Rating is self-reported on its own site; review count not shown

license.name: Restroom Stalls and All (RSA)
license.registry: Georgia State Licensing Board for Residential and General Contractors via Georgia SOS license verification (verify.sos.ga.gov)
license.note: Checked 2026-11-20. verify.sos.ga.gov and the SOS business search (ecorp.sos.ga.gov) both returned HTTP 403 to automated access, so no record could be read. Repo state research marks Georgia 'unclear': the state requires a license for general contracting over $2,500, but specialty trade work may be exempt. That isn't confirmed. Augusta has no local rule recorded for this area. It isn't on the Alabama GC roster either. Check by hand at verify.sos.ga.gov.
